IUT1.ThmA.content: Construction of Θ^{±ell}NF-Hodge theaters from initial Θ-data, with an F_l^{⋊±}-symmetry on the additive side and an F_l^*-symmetry on the multiplicative side; the Θ-link from the Θ-pilot data of one theater to the q-pilot data of another, which induces a full poly-isomorphism of the unit portions; Frobenius-pictures and étale-pictures.
explicit_hypotheses: A fixed collection of initial Θ-data (Definition 3.1).
IUT1.ThmA.conclusion: Summary statement of Corollaries 3.7 to 3.9, 4.12, 6.10, 6.12 and Definition 6.13 in introductory form.
obligations: Every term needs a definition: Frobenioids, D-prime-strips, Hodge theaters, poly-isomorphisms.
ambiguities: Introductory summary; the precise content is in the corollaries of §§3 to 6.

IUT1.ThmB.content: For a hyperbolic curve over a mixed characteristic local field with stable reduction, profinite conjugates of tempered decomposition and inertia groups that land in the tempered group are tempered conjugates.
explicit_hypotheses: X a hyperbolic curve over an MLF k with stable model; Π^tp_X tempered fundamental group; Π_X its profinite completion.
IUT1.ThmB.conclusion: Same content as Corollary 2.5 with Σ = Primes.

obligations: Tempered fundamental groups are not in Mathlib.

explicit_hypotheses: k of characteristic zero; l ≥ 5 prime; X once-punctured elliptic curve over k; assumption (∗) that G_k acts trivially on Δ_X^ab ⊗ Z/lZ in the relevant setting.
obligations: Orbicurves (stacks) are not in Mathlib.

IUT1.Thm2_6.content: Let F contain a finite index subgroup G that is free of finite rank or an orientable surface group of genus ≥ 2, and H ⊆ F an infinite subgroup. If γ in the profinite completion satisfies γHγ^{-1} ⊆ F, then with H_G = H ∩ G one has γ ∈ F · N(closure of H_G); if H_G is nonabelian then γ ∈ F.
explicit_hypotheses: G ⊆ F of finite index, G free of finite rank or orientable surface group of genus ≥ 2
implicit_hypotheses: F residually finite, cited from [Config] Proposition 7.1 (ii).
IUT1.Thm2_6.conclusion: γ ∈ F · N_{F̂}(H̄_G), and γ ∈ F when H_G is nonabelian.
obligations: Statable in Lean: Mathlib has free groups and profinite completion of groups in some form; surface groups would need a definition. Not attempted.
ambiguities: The bars over H_G and the meaning of N_F̂ are lost in the extracted text; page 56 not rendered. The reading of the normalizer as taken in F̂ of the closure of H_G is from the text only.

obligations: Categories of tempered coverings and Aut-holomorphic orbispaces.

IUT1.Ex4_3.content: Model base-NF-bridge: the outer homomorphism Aut(D^⊚) → GL2(F_l)/{±1}; the semi-unipotent and Borel subgroups Aut_ε(C_K) ⊆ Aut(C_K); V^±un ⊆ V^Bor ⊆ 𝕍(K); Aut(C_K)/Aut_ε(C_K) ≅ F_l^*; poly-morphisms φ^NF_v and the model NF-bridge φ^NF : D_J → D^⊚.

IUT1.Ex4_4.content: Model base-Θ-bridge: evaluation sections at bad v, the D-prime-strip D_>, and the model φ^Θ : D_J → D_>.

IUT1.Ex4_5.content: Transport of label classes of cusps: for j ∈ F_l^*, the arrows φ^NF_j, φ^Θ_j induce an isomorphism of F_l^*-torsors φ^LC_j : LabCusp(D^⊚) ⥲ LabCusp(D_>), with φ^LC_j obtained from φ^LC_1 by the action of j; the class [ε] is the unique η with evaluation giving φ^LC_j ↦ j.

IUT1.Def4_6.content: (i) D-NF-bridge: a poly-morphism D_J → D^⊚ from a capsule of D-prime-strips, isomorphic to the model by conjugation; morphisms are pairs (capsule-full poly-isomorphism, Aut_ε-orbit of isomorphisms) compatible with the arrows. (ii) D-Θ-bridge: a poly-morphism D_J → D_>, isomorphic to the model; morphisms are pairs (capsule-full poly-isomorphism, full poly-isomorphism). (iii) D-ΘNF-Hodge theater: a D-NF-bridge and a D-Θ-bridge sharing the capsule D_J, jointly isomorphic to the model; morphisms are compatible pairs inducing the same bijection of index sets.
ambiguities: Composition of morphisms is described as evident.

IUT1.Prop4_7.content: For a D-ΘNF-Hodge theater: (i) the D-Θ-bridge determines a bijection χ : J ⥲ F_l^*; (ii) restriction via the j-th parts of the bridges gives isomorphisms of F_l^*-torsors φ^LC_j, obtained from φ^LC_1 by the action of χ(j); (iii) there is a unique [ε] ∈ LabCusp(D^⊚) with φ^LC_j([ε]) ↦ χ(j), giving ζ : LabCusp(D^⊚) ⥲ J.
IUT1.Prop4_7.conclusion: Labels on the capsule and the element [ε].

IUT1.Prop4_8.content: (i) Isomorphisms between two D-NF-bridges form an F_l^*-torsor. (ii) Isomorphisms between two D-Θ-bridges, or two D-ΘNF-Hodge theaters, form a set of cardinality one. (iii) Gluings of a D-NF-bridge and a D-Θ-bridge into a D-ΘNF-Hodge theater form an F_l^*-torsor. (iv) A functorial algorithm constructs, up to F_l^*-indeterminacy, a D-ΘNF-Hodge theater from a D-NF-bridge.
obligations: A formal proof needs the model objects; the torsor statements are combinatorial once the automorphism groups of the models are known.

IUT1.Ex5_1.content: Global Frobenioids F^⊛ and F^⊚ over D^⊛ and D^⊚, κ-coric functions, and the realification.
ambiguities: Only parts of pages 123 to 131 were read; the record is an orientation summary, not an extraction.

IUT1.Def5_2.content: F-prime-strips {F_v}: at nonarchimedean v a Frobenioid equivalent to the model, at archimedean v a triple with Kummer structure; F^⊢-prime-strips; morphisms are collections of isomorphisms; F^⊩-prime-strips (C^⊩, Prime(C^⊩) ⥲ V, F^⊢, {ρ_v}); parts (v) to (viii) on ∞κ-coric and κ-coric structures, including the Kummer structure cyclotomic isomorphism at archimedean v.

IUT1.Cor5_3.content: (i) Isom of the global Frobenioids to Isom of their bases is bijective. (ii) Isom of F-prime-strips to Isom of the associated D-prime-strips is bijective. (iii) For F^⊢-prime-strips the map is surjective. (iv) Aut(F_v) → Aut(D_v) is bijective at bad v.
IUT1.Cor5_3.conclusion: Reconstruction of Frobenioid data from base data.

IUT1.Ex5_4.content: Model Θ- and NF-bridges: the F-prime-strip †F_> tautologically associated to a Θ-Hodge theater; capsules F_J; ψ^Θ lying over φ^Θ (Remark 5.3.1); δ-valuations and the localized F-prime-strip F^⊚|_δ, well defined up to isomorphism; poly-morphisms to F^⊚; the unique ψ^NF over φ^NF (Corollary 5.3 (ii)); restriction functors and pivotal distributions.
ambiguities: F^⊚|_δ is only defined up to isomorphism (page 148), so poly-morphisms into F^⊚ are defined as full poly-isomorphisms to some such localization.

IUT1.Def5_5.content: (i) NF-bridge: (F_J, F^⊚, F^⊛, the restriction arrow, ψ^NF) where ψ^NF lifts a D-NF-bridge. (ii) Θ-bridge: (F_J, F_>, HT^Θ, ψ^Θ) with F_> tautologically associated to the Θ-Hodge theater and ψ^Θ determined by a D-Θ-bridge. (iii) ΘNF-Hodge theater: an NF-bridge and a Θ-bridge with a common capsule, lifting a D-ΘNF-Hodge theater. Morphisms are compatible collections of poly-isomorphisms.
ambiguities: Morphisms of Θ-bridges use isomorphisms of Θ-Hodge theaters (Remark 3.6.2), whose definition is left to the reader.

IUT1.Cor5_6.content: (i) Isomorphisms of Θ-Hodge theaters biject with isomorphisms of the associated D-prime-strips. (ii) Isomorphisms of NF-bridges, Θ-bridges, ΘNF-Hodge theaters biject with those of the associated D-objects. (iii) Gluings of an NF-bridge and a Θ-bridge form an F_l^*-torsor.
IUT1.Cor5_6.conclusion: Bijections on isomorphism sets and torsor of gluings.
ambiguities: The task names "Proposition 5.6"; the paper's statement with that number is Corollary 5.6. There is no Proposition 5.6 in §5.

IUT1.Def6_1.content: F_l^{⋊±} = F_l ⋊ {±1}; F_l^±-groups and F_l^±-torsors with Aut_+ and Aut_±; positive and α-signed +-full poly-isomorphisms of D-prime-strips; LabCusp^± as an F_l^±-torsor; D^{⊚±} = B(X_K)^0 with Aut_± ⊇ Aut_csp and the isomorphism Aut_±(D^{⊚±})/Aut_csp ⥲ F_l^{⋊±}, depending on ε; V^± ⊆ 𝕍(K).
ambiguities: The ⋊ in F_l^{⋊±} is lost in the extracted text and was read from renders.

IUT1.Ex6_2.content: Model base-Θ^±-bridge: copies D_t, t ∈ F_l, of the tautological D-prime-strip, positive +-full poly-isomorphisms to D_≻, the capsule D_±, the poly-automorphism −1_{F_l} of order two, and α-signed poly-automorphisms for α ∈ {±1}^V.

IUT1.Ex6_3.content: Model base-Θ^ell-bridge: fix LabCusp^±(D^{⊚±}) ≅ F_l; poly-morphisms φ^{Θell}_t : D_t → D^{⊚±} built from β ∘ φ ∘ α with α ∈ Aut_+(D_v), β ∈ Aut_csp(D^{⊚±}); equivariant poly-action of F_l^{⋊±}.

IUT1.Def6_4.content: l^± = (l+1)/2. (i) D-Θ^±-bridge: a poly-morphism D_T → D_≻ with T an F_l^±-group, isomorphic to the model; the capsules D_{|T|} and D_{T^*}; morphisms are capsule-+-full poly-isomorphisms over F_l^±-group isomorphisms and +-full poly-isomorphisms. (ii) D-Θ^ell-bridge: D_T → D^{⊚±} with T an F_l^±-torsor; morphisms use Aut_csp-orbits. (iii) D-Θ^{±ell}-Hodge theater: a D-Θ^±-bridge and a D-Θ^ell-bridge on one capsule, isomorphic to the model.

IUT1.Prop6_6.content: (i) Isomorphisms of D-Θ^±-bridges form a torsor over {±1} × ∏_{v∈V}{±1}. (ii) Isomorphisms of D-Θ^ell-bridges form an F_l^{⋊±}-torsor. (iii) Isomorphisms of D-Θ^{±ell}-Hodge theaters form a {±1}-torsor. (iv) Gluings form a torsor over F_l^{⋊±} × ∏_{v∈V}{±1}. (v) A functorial algorithm constructs a D-Θ^{±ell}-Hodge theater from a D-Θ^ell-bridge, up to the indeterminacy of (iv).

IUT1.Prop6_7.content: From a D-Θ^±-bridge, by passing to D_{T^*}, identifying D_≻ with D_0, and replacing +-full poly-morphisms by full ones at good v and by those of Example 4.4 at bad v, a functorial algorithm produces a D-Θ-bridge D_{T^*} → D_>, well defined up to unique isomorphism.
IUT1.Prop6_7.conclusion: Construction of a D-Θ-bridge from a D-Θ^±-bridge.
obligations: Proof: "follows immediately from the definitions".

IUT1.Cor6_10.content: The D-Θ^{±ell}-link between D-Θ^{±ell}-Hodge theaters is the full poly-isomorphism of the mono-analytic D^⊢-prime-strips D^⊢_>; the resulting étale-picture with its symmetries.

IUT1.Def6_11.content: (i) Θ^±-bridge: a poly-morphism F_T → F_≻ of F-prime-strips lifting a D-Θ^±-bridge (Corollary 5.3 (ii)); capsules F_{|T|}, F_{T^*}. (ii) Θ^ell-bridge: F_T → D^{⊚±}, which is by definition a D-Θ^ell-bridge on the associated capsule of D-prime-strips. (iii) Θ^{±ell}-Hodge theater: a Θ^±-bridge and a Θ^ell-bridge whose associated D-data form a D-Θ^{±ell}-Hodge theater; morphisms induce the same poly-isomorphism of capsules.

IUT1.Cor6_12.content: (i) Isomorphisms of Θ^±-bridges, Θ^ell-bridges, Θ^{±ell}-Hodge theaters biject with those of the associated D-objects. (ii) Gluings of a Θ^±-bridge and a Θ^ell-bridge form a torsor over F_l^{⋊±} × ∏_{v∈V}{±1}.

IUT1.Def6_13.content: (i) A Θ^{±ell}NF-Hodge theater is a triple: a Θ^{±ell}-Hodge theater, a ΘNF-Hodge theater, and the necessarily unique gluing isomorphism between them (Remark 6.12.2). The D-version is defined in the same way.
ambiguities: Uniqueness of the gluing is asserted in Remark 6.12.2 via Proposition 6.7; it is a claim, recorded as such.
